Class EventStreams

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.sse.EventStreams
@Internal public final class EventStreams extends Object
The server-sent events of the response of an AsyncStreamingHttpClient exchange, decoded from the body bytes the client received.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

  • Method Details

    • response

      public static <B> HttpResponse<BodyElements<Event<B>>> response(ByteBodyHttpResponse<?> response, MessageBodyHandlerRegistry handlerRegistry, Argument<B> eventType, long maxBufferSize)
      The response of an exchange whose body bytes the client received: the events of an event stream, decoded as they are read, or a body of another type, decoded whole as one event. The events take over the bytes of the response.
      Type Parameters:
      B - The event data type
      Parameters:
      response - The response, with a status that is not an error
      handlerRegistry - The readers of the event data
      eventType - The event data type
      maxBufferSize - The maximum size of a line, and of the data of one event
      Returns:
      The response, whose body is the events

      The response of an exchange whose body bytes the client received: the events of an event stream, decoded as they are read, or a body of another type, decoded whole as one event. The events take over the bytes of the response.
      Type Parameters:

      response - The response, with a status that is not an error
      handlerRegistry - The readers of the event data
      eventType - The event data type
      maxBufferSize - The maximum size of a line, and of the data of one event

    • response

      public static <B> HttpResponse<BodyElements<Event<B>>> response(HttpResponse<BodyElements<ByteBuffer<?>>> response, Argument<B> eventType, long maxBufferSize, Supplier<JsonMapper> jsonMapper)
      The response of an exchange whose body is read as its pieces: the events of an event stream, decoded as the pieces are read, or a body of another type, decoded whole as one event. The data is decoded with the supplied JsonMapper; a String or a byte[] is taken as it is. The events take over the pieces of the response.
      Type Parameters:
      B - The event data type
      Parameters:
      response - The response, with a status that is not an error
      eventType - The event data type
      maxBufferSize - The maximum size of a line, of the data of one event, and of a body that is not an event stream
      jsonMapper - Supplies the mapper when the event type needs JSON decoding
      Returns:
      The response, whose body is the events
